# Gold Finance Management

> A jewellery shop ledger app for tracking gold, silver and combination transactions, customer details, item weights and payment reminders.

Gold Finance Management is a web application for jewellery shops to manage daily customer transactions, weights, amounts and pending payment reminders. The main dashboard and records pages require an account.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page that redirects signed-in users to their dashboard.
- [Login](/login): Sign in to an existing shop account.
- [Register](/register): Create a new shop account.
